title: Rotation minutes: top-8 shares and replacement shares
method: minutes summed from the official box score of each team's last 10 completed games; share = player minutes / team minutes

DET.replacement_rule: when a player is out their minutes are redistributed to the remaining players in proportion to their measured minutes share
DET.source: official NBA box score pages, last 10 games played
